mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 65 degrees at Harriet Park under partly cloudy skies with a waxing gibbous moon. The International Space Station passes overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

Public Works crews are preparing for fall leaf collection starting October 5, and the city is also reviewing various development plans, including a site plan for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.
Today is packed with local options including the farmer's market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at the Bogey Factory, while tomorrow you can join in for Hop Haus trivia.
In a noteworthy call from September 10, officers responded to an in-progress burglary where a suspect fired a shot and was later detained after sustaining an injury.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a building remodel, so there is no flavor of the day to report at this time.
